prompt: This page is cited in drug-encyclopedia entries on synthetic cathinones, for these substances: alpha-PVP (α-PVP). Say 'not given' for anything the page does not contain. Do not add anything that is not on the page, and do not quote any passage longer than 15 words.
answer:
**(1) Chemical identifiers, names and control status**

- **IUPAC/systematic name:** 1-phenyl-2-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)pentan-1-one
- **Other names on the page:** 1-Phenyl-2-(1-pyrrolidinyl)-1-pentanone; 1-Phenyl-2-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)pentan-1-on (German); 1-Fenyyli-2-(1-pyrrolidinyyli)-1-pentanoni (Finnish); 2-(1-Pyrrolidinyl)-valerophenone; 2-Pyrrolidinovalerophenone; 2-(1-Pyrrolidinyl)-valerophenone; 2-(Pyrrolidin-1-yl)phenylpentan-1-one; 2-Pyrrolidin-1-yl-1-phenylpentan-1-one; α-Pyrrolidinopentiophenone; α-Pyrrolidinovalerophenone; α-Pyrrolidiinivalerofenoni (Finnish); α-Pyrrolidinovalerophenon (German); Desmethyl pyrovalerone; Prolintanone; β-keto-Prolintane; Pyrodilyl ketone; α-Pyrrolidino ketone; alpha-PVP, alfa-PVP, a-PVP, A PVP, PVP; α-2; CHEMBL205082; MFCD24386810; O-2387
- **Common name:** alpha-pyrrolidinovalerophenone
- **Abbreviation:** α-PVP
- **CAS numbers:** 14530-33-7 (free base); 5485-65-4 (hydrochloride); 14859-27-9 (tartrate); 14859-28-0 (maleate); 14995-79-0 (citrate); 100175-06-2 (hydrogen maleate); 16121-74-7 (sulfate); 13415-49-1 (sulfate 1:1); 1346599-00-5 (d8-free base); 1781744-06-6 (d8-hydrochloride)
- **Molecular formula:** C15H21NO
- **Molecular weight:** 231.34
- **Monoisotopic mass:** 231.16231
- **ATC code:** not given
- **UN status:** Not listed in the 1961 Single Convention or the 1971 Convention on Psychotropic Substances; under assessment by the UN system (WHO's 37th ECDD meeting, November 2015; outcome unpublished).
- **EU/national status (as of the page):**
  - *Drug control legislation (16 Member States):* Czech Republic (1 Oct 2015); Estonia (2 Jun 2014); Finland (30 Dec 2013); France (2 Aug 2012); Germany (Schedule II, 17 Jul 2013); Greece (via equivalence to metazocine, law 3459/2006); Hungary (1 Jan 2015); Ireland (generic cathinone definition); Italy (29 Dec 2011, generic); Latvia (generic, Cabinet Regulation 847); Lithuania (cathinone derivative, 2010 amendment); Poland (Schedule IV, 1 Jul 2015); Romania (Law 143/2000 and Law 339/2005); Slovenia (July 2014); Sweden (1 Feb 2013); UK (generic substituted cathinones, April 2010)
  - *NPS-specific legislation (4):* Austria (generic group); Cyprus (24 Jun 2011); Portugal (Decree-Law 154/2013, 17 Apr 2013); Slovakia ("hazardous substance", 1 Oct 2013)
  - *Other:* Netherlands treats consumer sales as a medicinal product. Turkey (Law 2313, 22 Mar 2012) and Norway (generic cathinone definition) also control it.
  - *Not controlled (7):* Belgium (process to control started), Bulgaria, Croatia, Denmark, Luxembourg, Malta, Spain.
  - *China:* placed under national control on 1 Oct 2015.

**(2) Forms, products and findings**

- **Physical form:** Hydrochloride salt described as a "white, crystalline powder"; most powder seizures white or off-white; one Spanish powder described as "black rock powder."
- **Forms detected:** powder; tablets (12,400 units seized); powder-filled capsules; vegetable material (<150 g); liquids (<150 ml); blotters (68 units); jelly gums (2 units).
- **Historical 1960s formulations (patents):** tablets up to 60 mg; suppositories 1–60 mg; dragées 30 mg; ampules 10 mg/2 mL; drops 60 mg/mL.
- **Retail:** sold online in retail quantities from 1 g upwards and in kilogram wholesale quantities.
- **Labelled "legal high" products reported to contain α-PVP:**
  - Belgium: 'Yayo soft', 'Yayo experimental', '1NRG'
  - Cyprus: 'Ocean Breath'
  - Czech Republic: 'Guarana Coco jumbo', 'Cherry Coco jumbo', 'ILOVEPARADE', 'SENSATION'
  - France: 'NRG3', 'Energy 3', 'PV-11'
  - Germany: 'Pure NRG'
  - Italy: 'A-1 PUP'
  - Poland: 'E21', 'G-Y', 'S1 Turbo', 'GIE-ES M'
  - Portugal: 'Sextacy', 'Bloom', 'Quick Silver', 'Formula 3', 'Ivory', 'Vanila [sic] Sky'
  - Slovakia: 'Doves', 'Fire Ball', 'Green Speed', 'Knock out', 'Max', 'Speedway', 'Total speed', 'Ultra Violet Exclusive'
  - UK: 'NRG-3', 'Energy - 3 (NRG-3)', 'Spellweaver'
  - Some are marketed as "research chemicals," "bath salts," "plant food" or "insect repellents."
- **Seizure and detection findings:**
  - Over 5,200 seizures reported; more than 750 kg of powder seized in Europe since 2011.
  - Single seizure of almost 260 kg in Spain (April 2015), in 13 containers from China at Barcelona Airport.
  - Two illicit production sites seized in Poland (2013 and 2014).
  - Two Hungarian tableting sites linked to pentedrone tablets (800 g and 1.5 kg of α-PVP powder seized).
  - Purity data for 17 seizures ranged from 23% (2 seizures) to over 95% (8 seizures).
  - About 35% of seizures contained α-PVP with other substances, mainly stimulants.
  - Some seized tablets had ecstasy-like colours, markings and logos.
